purpose: Describe the emergence of a suggestive atmosphere or quality.
keywords: Established N + めく / めいた
The sunlight is starting to feel springlike.
True feelings showed through the joking words.
formation: Established N + めく / めいた
restrictions: Common with 春, 謎, and 冗談.
mistake: Unlike ぶる, it need not imply deliberate pretence.
